D: Three minions travel to 1968 Villain-Con looking for a new evil boss.
P: Serve the snacks when Kevin, Stuart and Bob arrive at Villain-Con.
S: Banana chunks in a light soda water batter, fried and drizzled with honey

Banana chunks dipped in a light soda water batter, fried golden and crisp, drizzled with honey and sprinkled with crushed peanuts. Whisk 100g self-raising flour, 2 tbsp cornflour, 1 tbsp caster sugar and a pinch of salt with 170ml cold soda water into a smooth batter. Cut 4 firm bananas into 4cm chunks. Heat oil to 180C. Dip the banana in batter and fry in batches for 2 to 3 minutes until golden. Drain on paper towel, drizzle with honey and scatter with 50g crushed roasted peanuts. Eat while hot.
frankfurts in buns with beef chilli, cheddar and fried onions, for the Nelsons' road trip

Grilled franks in soft buns loaded with quick beef chilli, melted cheddar, sticky fried onions and mustard, wrapped in paper. Fry 250g beef mince with half a diced onion, 1 tsp cumin and 1 tsp mild chilli powder, add 200g passata and simmer 15 minutes until thick. Slowly fry 2 sliced onions in butter for 15 minutes until golden. Grill 8 franks until they split. Split and toast 8 hot dog buns, add the franks, spoon over chilli, top with 100g grated cheddar, onions and mustard. Wrap in paper.
Puff pastry twists with cheddar and parmesan
Puff pastry strips twisted with cheddar and parmesan, baked at 200C for 12 minutes until golden as a crown.
M: Poached shredded chicken in curry mayo with apricot jam and sultanas
Cold chicken in a curried mayonnaise with apricot and sultanas, served on rice or soft rolls.
Scarlet's castle roast beef and Yorkshires
topside cooked medium, with crisp batter puddings, potatoes and pan gravy, fit for the new queen

Beef topside roasted at 200C to medium, rested, with Yorkshire puddings, roast potatoes and gravy. Rub a 1.5kg beef topside with oil, salt and pepper and roast at 200C for 50 minutes for medium. Rest 15 minutes. Roast 1kg parboiled potatoes in hot oil for 50 minutes. Whisk 140g plain flour, 4 eggs and 200ml milk into a batter. Heat 1 tsp oil in each hole of a 12-hole muffin tin at 230C, pour in the batter and bake 20 minutes without opening the oven. Make gravy from the pan juices, 1 tbsp flour and 300ml stock.
W: Bananas split under vanilla ice cream and hot chocolate fudge

Bananas split lengthways with three scoops of ice cream, hot fudge, whipped cream and a cherry. Heat 150ml cream and pour over 150g chopped dark chocolate, stirring into hot fudge. Split 4 bananas lengthways into long dishes. Add three scoops of vanilla ice cream to each, pour over the fudge and top with whipped cream and a maraschino cherry.
K: Banana, vanilla ice cream, milk and salted caramel, blended thick

Ripe bananas blended with vanilla ice cream, cold milk and salted caramel until thick, topped with whipped cream and a banana slice. Blend 3 ripe bananas with 6 scoops vanilla ice cream, 400ml cold milk and 3 tbsp salted caramel sauce until thick and smooth. Drizzle a little more caramel inside 4 tall glasses and pour in the shake. Top each with a swirl of whipped cream, a banana slice and a final drizzle of caramel. Serve with wide straws.
